### Borea v0.6.19

A patch release for the search in Discover. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- Each Discover tab keeps its own search. Before, a search on the Mods tab also filtered the vehicles, saves and mod loaders, so another tab could look almost empty. When you come back to a tab, its search is there again.

Full changelog: [v0.6.18...v0.6.19](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.18...v0.6.19)
